title: 構造設計演習
subtitle: Exercise of Structual Design
teachers:
TANAKA Yasushi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
To understand the mechanism of seismic damage in infrastructures.
To understand basic theory of seismic design.
To understand dynamic analysis by solving the equation of motion.
To understand numerical programing of time history response analysis with finite difference method.
advice: In quake prone countries like Japan, specifications of substructures are decided from seismic design in most cases. Students will learn seismic damage and history of seismic design of reinforced concrete columns in this class. Static lateral force method was used in the past. On the other hand, dynamic analysis is now used for seismic design owing to the development of ICTs. Therefore, students will learn present style of seismic design through the programing of time history response analysis.
books: コンクリート系構造物の耐震設計法、大内一、森北出版
requiredKnowledge: Students are requested to have a basic skill of structural mechanics. Therefore, students are required to have learn structural mechanics I, structural mechanics II and structural mechanics analysis which are bachelor's classes.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In quake prone countries like Japan, specifications of substructures are decided from seismic design in most cases. Students will learn seismic damage and history of seismic design of reinforced concrete columns in this class. Static lateral force method was used in the past. On the other hand, dynamic analysis is now used for seismic design owing to the development of ICTs. Therefore, students will learn present style of seismic design through the programing of time history response analysis.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              コンクリート系構造物の耐震設計法、大内一、森北出版

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Students are requested to have a basic skill of structural mechanics. Therefore, students are required to have learn structural mechanics I, structural mechanics II and structural mechanics analysis which are bachelor's classes.
